name: Barbara Ann

scaling.scaled: Reduce loads to what allows unbroken sets of 10+ in round one, and cut to 3-4 rounds before touching the 3-minute rests.
scaling.beginner: Do Barbara scaled instead, and come back to the weighted variant with a strength base.

origin.summary: A latter-day heavier variation on Barbara from CrossFit.com's expansion of the Girls series: the same five-round, rest-defined structure, with the bodyweight movements traded for weighted work that changes what the three minutes of rest can actually recover. Part of CrossFit's original 'Girls' benchmark series — named workouts introduced by founder Greg Glassman starting in 2003, on the logic that anything that leaves you flat on your back deserves a name like a storm. They serve as repeatable fitness tests: revisit one every few months and the clock tells you whether you're fitter. First posted to CrossFit.com on 2021-01-04.

description: Five rounds of handstand push-ups, deadlifts, sit-ups, and double-unders, with a mandatory three-minute rest between rounds — a four-movement update to Barbara's rest-interval format.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
